UserAccountProfile.title: User Account Profile
UserAccountProfile.description: Authenticated user account metadata and synced profile avatar shared across linked devices.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

displayName.description: User display name from Google Sign-In.

email.description: User email address from Google Sign-In.

photoUrl.description: Optional remote profile photo URL from Google Sign-In.

avatarBase64.description: Optional compressed JPEG thumbnail in Base64 synced across connected devices, or empty string when cleared.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when user profile was first created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

SyncedDevice.title: Synced Device
SyncedDevice.description: Individual Android device linked under the user's account for optional cross-device lock sync.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

syncEnabled.description: Whether this device receives and participates in synced lock commands.

lastSeenAt.description: Server timestamp when this device last synced (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when device was registered (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when device record was updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

SyncedLockCommand.title: Synced Lock Command
SyncedLockCommand.description: Latest cross-device focus lock trigger broadcast to linked devices with sync enabled.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

commandId.description: Unique UUID string for deduplicating lock triggers.

originDeviceId.description: Device installation ID that issued the lock trigger.

originDeviceName.description: Display name of the device that issued the lock trigger.

freeUseDurationMinutes.description: Delay window in minutes before lock enforcement activates (0 for instant/scheduled).

lockDurationMinutes.description: Total focus lock duration in minutes.

issuedAtWallMs.description: Origin wall-clock epoch milliseconds when lock trigger was created.

freeUseDeadlineWallMs.description: Target epoch milliseconds when delayed free-use ends (0 when not delayed).

lockExpirationWallMs.description: Target epoch milliseconds when lock enforcement ends.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when command doc was first created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest command broadcast (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}.description: Account owner profile document containing display info and synced thumbnail avatar.

/users/{userId}/devices/{deviceId}.description: Connected Android devices registered under the owner's Google account.

/users/{userId}/sync/{syncDocId}.description: Single deterministic sync document (lock_command) broadcasting cross-device focus locks.
